title: E2E: SMTP session routing via native sieve scripts
description:
End-to-end integration test: full SMTP session with native sieve scripts routing messages.

What: crates/smtp/tests/sieve_native_e2e.rs (extend or replace existing sieve e2e tests)

Tests (these are the same scenarios as the existing smtp sieve tests; if they already pass after the dep swap in W5, this bead is mostly verification):

1. fileinto_newsgroup_prefix: upload script 'require ["fileinto"]; fileinto "newsgroup:comp.test";'; send SMTP message; assert article in NNTP queue under comp.test; 250 OK.
2. reject_returns_550: upload 'reject "policy";'; send message; assert 550 response; nothing in queue.
3. discard_returns_250_nothing_stored: upload 'discard;'; send; 250 OK; INBOX empty; queue empty.
4. header_conditional_routing: script checks 'header :contains "Subject" "rust"'; send matching message → newsgroup; send non-matching → INBOX.
5. variables_routing: script uses set+fileinto with variable; message routes to correct newsgroup.
6. implicit_keep_no_script: no script uploaded for user; message delivered to INBOX.

All assertions use the same store query helpers as existing smtp integration tests.
